title: AI Automation Engineer - London
description:
AI Automation Engineer

London, Hybrid

£60,000- £70,000

We're looking for an AI Automation Engineer to join a growing technology team and help improve how the business operates through automation. This is a hands-on role where you'll work with stakeholders across the business to identify inefficiencies, streamline processes and deliver practical solutions that make a real difference.

You'll have the opportunity to influence how automation is implemented, take ownership of projects from idea through to delivery, and play a key role in a function that's continuing to grow.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Building and supporting automated workflows using modern automation tools.
  • Integrating business systems and applications through APIs.
  • Using AI where it adds genuine value to business processes.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Supporting and enhancing existing automations.
  • Working closely with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience delivering automation solutions in a commercial environment.
  • Knowledge of platforms such as Power Automate, Logic Apps, n8n, Make, Zapier or similar.
  • Experience working with APIs and systems integrations.
  • Strong Python and/or JavaScript skills.
  • Understanding of SQL and data-driven applications.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Why Apply?

  • Opportunity to make a tangible impact across the business.
  • Significant ownership and autonomy.
  • Chance to shape the organisation's approach to automation.
  • Varied project work across multiple teams and business functions.
  • Modern technology stack and a growing data and technology environment.

This role would suit someone who enjoys solving business problems, building useful solutions and wants the opportunity to help shape a growing automation capability.
